judge_panel.matching_evidence:
1.  **Critical mathematical errors in the MILP capacity constraint:**
    Eq. (8) formulates the link capacity constraint as $f_{ij} \le C_{ij} + x_{ij}$. This is algebraically flawed for an MILP. If the directed edge is not selected ($x_{ij} = 0$), the inequality evaluates to $f_{ij} \le C_{ij}$, incorrectly allowing up to $C_{ij}$ units of traffic to flow over an inactive link. 
    *Recommendation:* Correct the capacity constraint to the standard Big-M or direct product form: $f_{ij} \le C_{ij} \cdot x_{ij}$, which ensures flow is strictly zero when the link is inactive.
